title: Randomized Logspace Is Contained in Bounded-Error Logspace
statement: Every language of Boolean strings decidable in randomized logspace with one-sided error is decidable in bounded-error randomized logspace: there is a constant-factor logspace machine that halts within a finite time bound on every input and outputs the correct membership bit with probability at least $2/3$.
hypotheses_covered: The language is in $RL$, meaning it has a one-sided-error randomized logspace decider
